292:     struct Queue<T> {
293:         buffer: Vec<PCell<T>>,
294:         head: AtomicU64<_, FifoQueue::head<T>, _>,

298:     }

300:     pub closed spec fn wf(&self) -> bool {
301:         predicate {
302:             &&& self.instance@.backing_cells().len() == self.buffer@.len()
303:             &&& forall|i: int| 0 <= i && i < self.buffer@.len() as int ==>
304:                 self.instance@.backing_cells().index(i) ==
305:                     self.buffer@.index(i).id()
306:         }
307:

309:             &&& g.instance_id() == instance@.id()
310:             &&& g.value() == v as int
311:         }
312: 
313:         invariant on tail with (instance) is (v: u64, g: FifoQueue::tail<T>) {
314:             &&& g.instance_id() == instance@.id()
315:             &&& g.value() == v as int
316:         }
317:     }
318: }

326: impl<T> Producer<T> {
327:     pub closed spec fn wf(&self) -> bool {
328:         (*self.queue).wf()
329:             && self.producer@.instance_id() == (*self.queue).instance@.id()
330:             && self.producer@.value() == ProducerState::Idle(self.tail as nat)
331:             && (self.tail as int) < (*self.queue).buffer@.len()
332:     }

339: }

341: impl<T> Consumer<T> {
342:     pub closed spec fn wf(&self) -> bool {
343:         (*self.queue).wf()
344:             && self.consumer@.instance_id() == (*self.queue).instance@.id()
345:             && self.consumer@.value() == ConsumerState::Idle(self.head as nat)
346:             && (self.head as int) < (*self.queue).buffer@.len()
347:     }
348: }

350: pub fn new_queue<T>(len: usize) -> (pc: (Producer<T>, Consumer<T>))
351:     requires
352:         len > 0,
353:     ensures
354:         pc.0.wf(),
355:         pc.1.wf(),
356: {
357:     let mut backing_cells_vec = Vec::<PCell<T>>::new();
358:     let tracked mut perms = Map::<nat, cell::PointsTo<T>>::tracked_empty();
359:     while backing_cells_vec.len() < len
360:         invariant
361:             forall|j: nat|
362:                 #![trigger( perms.dom().contains(j) )]
363:                 #![trigger( backing_cells_vec@.index(j as int) )]
364:                 #![trigger( perms.index(j) )]
365:                 0 <= j && j < backing_cells_vec.len() as int ==> perms.dom().contains(j)
366:                     && backing_cells_vec@.index(j as int).id() == perms.index(j).id()
367:                     && perms.index(j).is_uninit(),
368:     {
369:         let ghost i = backing_cells_vec.len();
370:         let (cell, cell_perm) = PCell::empty();
371:         backing_cells_vec.push(cell);
372:         proof {
373:             perms.tracked_insert(i as nat, cell_perm.get());
374:         }
375:         assert(perms.dom().contains(i as nat));
376:         assert(backing_cells_vec@.index(i as int).id() == perms.index(i as nat).id());
377:         assert(perms.index(i as nat).is_uninit());
378:     }
379: 
380:     let ghost mut backing_cells_ids = Seq::<CellId>::new(
381:         backing_cells_vec@.len(),
382:         |i: int| backing_cells_vec@.index(i).id(),
383:     );
384:     let tracked (
385:         Tracked(instance),
386:         Tracked(head_token),
387:         Tracked(tail_token),
388:         Tracked(producer_token),
389:         Tracked(consumer_token),
390:     ) = FifoQueue::Instance::initialize(backing_cells_ids, perms, perms);
391:     let tracked_inst: Tracked<FifoQueue::Instance<T>> = Tracked(instance.clone());
392:     let head_atomic = AtomicU64::new(Ghost(tracked_inst), 0, Tracked(head_token));
393:     let tail_atomic = AtomicU64::new(Ghost(tracked_inst), 0, Tracked(tail_token));
394:     let queue = Queue::<T> {
395:         instance: Tracked(instance),
396:         head: head_atomic,
397:         tail: tail_atomic,
398:         buffer: backing_cells_vec,
399:     };
400:     let queue_arc = Arc::new(queue);
401:     let prod = Producer::<T> {
402:         queue: queue_arc.clone(),
403:         tail: 0,
404:         producer: Tracked(producer_token),
405:     };
406:     let cons = Consumer::<T> { queue: queue_arc, head: 0, consumer: Tracked(consumer_token) };
407:     (prod, cons)

410: impl<T> Producer<T> {
411:     fn enqueue(&mut self, t: T)
412:         requires
413:             old(self).wf(),
414:         ensures
415:             final(self).wf(),
416:     {
417:         loop
418:             invariant

434:                     cell_perm = if head != next_tail as u64 {

442:             if head != next_tail as u64 {
443:                 let tracked mut cell_perm = match cell_perm {
444:                     Option::Some(cp) => cp,
445:                     Option::None => {
446:                         assert(false);
447:                         proof_from_false()
448:                     },
449:                 };

451:                 atomic_with_ghost!(&queue.tail => store(next_tail as u64); ghost tail_token => {
452:                     queue.instance.borrow().produce_end(cell_perm,
453:                         cell_perm, &mut tail_token, self.producer.borrow_mut());
454:                 });
